summary: Phase 31.1 Daily Report Crew Memory Continuity · end-to-end doctrine validation on /daily/submit (publicMode, no auth). 14/14 functional checks pass. Restore prompt renders correctly with summary chip, nickname rename works, Use Setup populates form, Start Blank preserves the record, Clear Saved Setup deletes it. TTL (30d) and schemaVersion mismatch both auto-purge on load. No silent auto-fill. Banned-word UI audit on /daily/submit returns ZERO hits with word-boundary matching. Phase 31 draft-restore-prompt coexists cleanly with the new crew-setup-prompt on the same screen. Doctrine field-stripping verified by static review of /app/frontend/src/lib/crewMemory.js — extractSetupSnapshot + _stripCrewRow/_stripSubRow/_stripEquipmentRow only emit the doctrine-allowed keys.

critical_code_review_comments: crewMemory.js is clean, well-documented, and doctrine-conformant. Defense-in-depth via double-call to extractSetupSnapshot inside saveCrewSetup is excellent.

applySetupSnapshotToData correctly re-pads empty banned-field columns (start_time, lunch_minutes, hours, work_performed, count, hours_used, time_*, notes) so the persisted record stays stripped while the live form has the runtime columns it needs.

Optional enhancement (NOT a blocker): consider rolling lastUsedAt only when the operator clicks Use Setup, NOT on every mount-time read. Currently loadCrewSetup is silent (good) and lastUsedAt is bumped only inside applySetupSnapshotToData (also good) — confirmed correct.
Optional enhancement: page-mount load currently calls loadCrewSetup which already purges expired/mismatched records as a side-effect of clearCrewSetup() — that's correct doctrine.
seed_data_creation: Seeded multiple localStorage snapshots at key `masci.crew-memory.daily-report.v1` for the various test scenarios. All cleaned up at end of testing (T6 left storage null; subsequent reseeds for nickname/TTL/schema tests overwrite the slot).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 31.1 fully validated on preview. Storage key is `masci.crew-memory.daily-report.v1` with TTL 30d and schemaVersion 1. To re-test: seed via `localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(snapshot))` then page.reload() to trigger the mount-time loadCrewSetup effect. Both data-testids `daily-report-crew-setup-prompt` (new) and `daily-report-draft-restore-prompt` (Phase 31) can render simultaneously on /daily/submit — this is by design. Banned-word scans must use WORD-BOUNDARY regex; naive substring matching gives a false positive on 'account' inside the legitimate term 'accountability'.
